storyPrompt: Write a quiet English story about checking a disputed delivery before a public demonstration. Aster is a practical conservator. Jo is an assistant who is allowed to disagree. Kei keeps the public records. The story takes place at the canopy station. The seed capsule must remain intact. No character may be physically injured. Keep practical actions precise. Use third-person past tense centred on Aster. Plan three chapters, each targeting 750 words. No earlier book or borrowed fictional world is assumed.
